name: Shell Tester
description: Shell Tester is the reference grain for exercising the Melusina shell extensions end to end: wallet connect and message signing, one-time passwords, NFT and license reads, the Solana RPC bridge, and the grain-local end-to-end encryption journal. It is a diagnostic surface for operators and app authors — it holds no custody, no screening, and no chain authority.
